credits.title: The Gospel of Christmas
credits.overview: A struggling pastor moves his family to a troubled New York neighborhood, where they must save a neglected church from foreclosure before Christmas.

credits.title: The Banker
credits.overview: In the 1960s, two entrepreneurs hatch an ingenious business plan to fight for housing integration—and equal access to the American Dream.

credits.title: The Immortal Life of Henrietta Lacks
credits.overview: An African-American woman becomes an unwitting pioneer for medical breakthroughs when her cells are used to create the first immortal human cell line in the early 1950s.

credits.title: The Christmas Swap
credits.overview: A holiday wish becomes a magical Christmas switch when two brothers magically switch bodies.

credits.title: A Product of Me
credits.overview: Clyde and Levi prepare for life after high school. Twists and turns allows for them to encounter adversaries that test their friendship, their strength, and the power to go on.
